errors.evidence: The image clearly contains a line plot with two lines and bars, representing exports, imports, and balance over time.
The machine-generated description does not mention the purpose of the chart, which is to illustrate the development of exports, imports, and balance from 2020 to 2023 in billion US dollars.
The description omits the axis labels, units, and scales, including the left vertical axis (0 to 400, linear scale) and the right vertical axis (-200 to 400, linear scale).
The description does not mention the presence of two lines (blue for imports, red for exports) and bars (representing balance), nor the legend explaining these elements.
